_readme.source: FAA d-TPP airport diagram 00289AD, cycle NE-2, effective 01 OCT 2026 to 29 OCT 2026 (https://aeronav.faa.gov/d-tpp/2610/00289ad.pdf), read visually at 600 dpi on Oct 2, 2026.
_readme.status: FIRST PASS. Taxiway roles, runway crossings, parallels and hot spots are read directly from the diagram and are reliable. The exact ORDER of connectors along a parallel and the far-ends of A and the west-side parallels are best reading; every edge carries a confidence field. Verify against the open diagram before the demo; do not present this graph as FAA data.

conventions.node_id: TWY/TWY for a taxiway intersection; TWY/RWY-side for a hold-short position where a taxiway meets a runway (side = which side of the runway); RWYxx/RWYyy for the runway intersection; AREA:name for named areas.
conventions.edge: {from, to, taxiway, kind: segment|runway_crossing|runway_exit|ramp_link, hold_short_required: bool, confidence}
conventions.hold_short: Every runway_crossing edge is bounded by two hold-short nodes. JO 7110.65 3-7-2 requires the controller to issue the hold-short and the pilot to read it back with the runway named; §3-1-3 requires ground to obtain local's approval before authorizing a crossing and to advise local when it is complete.

notes: ILS hold line on TWY B short of the 4 threshold: aircraft taxiing on B for a runway 4 departure may be instructed to hold at the ILS hold line (diagram caution).
ILS HOLD also marked near the 22 end on the R/U side.
Runway Status Lights in operation (all runways).

hot_spots.at: Intersection of RWY 4/22 and RWY 13/31, with TWYs P, R, S and AA converging just south of the crossing point
hot_spots.engine_note: Any authorization that touches 4/22 or 13/31 near HS1 touches both runways' protected areas.

hot_spots.at: TWY G / Q / B / AA where G crosses RWY 4/22 south-west of HS1
hot_spots.engine_note: G crossing of 4/22 is inside a hot spot; the B turn from the 13/31 parallel onto the 4/22 parallel happens here.

taxiways.role: Outer parallel: along the south side of RWY 13/31 from the 31 end to the HS2 area, then along the east side of RWY 4/22 south-west toward E/D. Serves the terminal alleys.
taxiways.confidence: roles reliable; order of V/N/W/Z near the 31 end is best reading

taxiways.role: Inner parallel: along the south side of RWY 13/31 from the 31 end to HS2, then turns south-west along the east side of RWY 4/22 to the 4 threshold (ILS hold line near the 4 end).
taxiways.confidence: roles and the turn at HS2 reliable; exact connector order best reading

runway_crossings.engine_note: Intersecting runways: an authorization on either runway reserves the intersection. LGA runs arrivals on 4 with departures on 13 routinely; the compatibility matrix must allow a takeoff on 13 with an arrival on 4 outside the controller's timing window (the 2026-03-22 00:13 'traffic inside three mile' takeoff clearance is the negative test).
